text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Solid lines: median forecast of F4 (thin orange line, with its 5% to 95% band) and of M* (wide blue line); seed 0. Dashed grey line: cleaned demand. Day 0 is the forecast origin (the first of the fold); no calendar date is shown. The day-ahead forecast is days 0.5 to 1.5 (leads of 12 h to 36 h). F4: neural network with neighbour rows. M*: the baseline of experiment 713, without neighbour rows. F4-R: F4 with its neighbours rewired to other Primaries (a placebo).'
text.tspan: Solid lines: median forecast of F4 (thin orange line, with its 5% to 95% band) and of M* (wide blue line); seed 0.
Dashed grey line: cleaned demand. Day 0 is the forecast origin (the first of the fold);
no calendar date is shown. The day-ahead forecast is days 0.5 to 1.5 (leads of 12 h to 36 h).
F4: neural network with neighbour rows.
M*: the baseline of experiment 713, without neighbour rows.
F4-R: F4 with its neighbours rewired to other Primaries (a placebo).
